grounding.states: Mark Carney is the current prime minister of Canada
grounding.from: Mark Carney is the current prime minister of Canada, as of today, Oct 12, 2026.
Wikipedia's list of Canadian prime ministers calls him the 24th and current prime minister.

value.answer: Mark Carney. He's Canada's 24th prime minister and has been in the job since 14 March 2025, and he's still in office as of this week.
